_sheet: Systems of the mod. One row = one C# class with one job. Preflight checks that each class exists in src and that every sheet it owns is referenced from it.

_columns.owns: sheets or generated tables this class is built from
_columns.dependsOn: other system ids, comma separated; - = none
_columns.testedBy: how it was verified (filled in during testing)

rows.responsibility: BepInEx entry: config, Harmony PatchAll, event subscriptions, per-frame tick, scene changes
rows.testedBy: Loads in PEAK 2.6.b with BepInEx 5.4.23.3 (v0.2.0 log: deck built, no errors)

rows.responsibility: the handler bodies the generated patches call; turns game moments into Session/Effects calls
rows.testedBy: Run start opened the opening pick on a hosted run and on Continue Run; lobby id logged on Host Game

rows.responsibility: the playable deck = every cards.json row; deals a hand with rarity weights and the unique rule from a seed; builds each card's effect lines
rows.testedBy: 8 placeholder cards built, hash logged; hands dealt with rarity weights

rows.responsibility: per-character card lists -> summed ClimbStats -> applied to the character's public fields (all clients) and consulted by the Harmony hooks (owner)
rows.testedBy: Picked the jump card: jump impulse 400 -> 480 (+20%) in the effects log

rows.responsibility: host: collects arrivals, orders players last-arrival-first, deals hands, advances turns, times out; everyone: tracks whose turn it is and opens the picker on their own turn
rows.testedBy: Opening pick by click recorded once (session 10001); host timeout and campfire flow carried over from 0.1.0 tests

rows.responsibility: RaiseEvent send helpers, EventReceived dispatch, late-joiner StateSync
rows.testedBy: PickSessionStart / PickMade round trip through Photon on a hosted lobby; multiplayer joins not yet tested

rows.responsibility: runtime-built uGUI: picker fan of cards, waiting banner, my-cards HUD, toasts
rows.testedBy: Five-card fan rendered with frames, rarity strips, art windows, names, coloured effect lines and flavour (checked from an in-game screenshot)

rows.responsibility: draws each shape as a generated anti-aliased sprite (cached) and stacks a motif's layers in the card's art window, animating them
rows.testedBy: All motifs used by the deck drawn and animated in game (star, snowflake, spring, rope, rock seen)

rows.responsibility: synthesises the UI sounds into AudioClips at load and plays them
rows.testedBy: Sounds synthesise without errors; not checked by ear

rows.responsibility: writes 'Hosting at <lobby id>' to %LOCALAPPDATA%/CampfireCards/net.log when this player creates a Steam lobby, for launchers that list open games
rows.testedBy: net.log line written on Host Game
